blends.name: Full Metal Solomon Montana
blends.desc:
# Solomon Montana in his final form!
He always dreamed about this powered armor, now he can quit a job in factory. He deserved it!

To receive this epic NFT you will need to blend [Temp Solomon Montana](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/pixelcorpses/blends/blend.nefty/36429) and [Full Metal Carton Box](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/pixelcorpses/drops/218190).

**Remember that in a result of blending, you will lost ingredients (NFTs will be burned), but you will receive unique pixel art!**

**This pixel art is hand made and has 50 frames** (more particulary: 100, but animation is in a loop)
**Only 50 pieces of this NFT in total!**

--------
* [Blends](https://neftyblocks.com/c/pixelcorpses/blends)
* [Drops](https://neftyblocks.com/c/pixelcorpses/)
* Low mint NFTs are on [AtomicMarket](https://wax.atomichub.io/market?primary_chain=wax-mainnet&collection_name=pixelcorpses&blockchain=wax-mainnet&order=desc&sort=created#sales)

* Follow me on [Twitter](https://twitter.com/hatouken)
* My website: [hatouken.com](http://hatouken.com)

blends.name: Temp Solomon Montana
blends.desc:
# Solomon Montana is now working!
But he dream about something else... Blend [Solomon Montana](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/pixelcorpses/drops/218186) with [Full Metal Factory](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/pixelcorpses/drops/218188) to get **Temp Solomon Montana**.

Then add [Full Metal Carton Box](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/pixelcorpses/drops/218190) in [this epic blend](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/pixelcorpses/blends/blend.nefty/36430/) and Solomon's dream come true - he will get brand, new powered armor!

**Remember that in a result of blending, you will lost ingredients (NFTs will be burned), but you will receive unique pixel art!**

blends.name: Mythic NyteWolf Warrior
blends.desc:
# Second collab between Hatouken & NyteWolf
Final form of **NyteWolf Warrior**.  Limited to only 22, because it takes 2 2 make a movement.

Check [Drops page](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/pixelcorpses/drops) for ingredients. You need [Epic NyteWolf Warrior](https://neftyblocks.com/c/pixelcorpses/blends/blend.nefty/23609) and [Epic 22 NyteWolf Hair](https://neftyblocks.com/c/pixelcorpses/blends/blend.nefty/23608) to blend them into Mythic NFT.
Details and tutorial are on my [Hatouken's blog](https://hatouken.wordpress.com/2023/02/11/hatouken-x-nytewolf-second-collab-is-here/).

Hatouken: https://hatouken.com/
NyteWolf: https://linktr.ee/nytewolf2222
